scope: Prerequisite review of the fifteen staged original documents, in source order; not a permanent source exclusion.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the two staged files were read. Linked references, package APIs, licenses, and concrete inputs were not independently verified. Source-reported tests and failures are not observations from this review. The parent must reconcile identities, totals, and citation bounds before import.

sources.workflow: Validate isotope-model inputs, simulate labeling, fit and profile constrained metabolic fluxes, and report identifiability and provenance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed atom maps, steady-state evidence, tracer distributions, corrected measurements and uncertainty, flux units and bounds, plus the stated local engine and model/data files.
sources.offline_assessment: A local synthetic-model candidate is described, conditional on the assets and runtime being available; no fit or simulation was executed here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual input-check and fit artifacts against source measurements and maps, then independently compare predictions and profiles; numerical feasibility cannot establish biological map correctness or steady state.

sources.workflow: Simulate closed homogeneous ignition, calculate the defined temperature-based delay, and compare refinement and conservation diagnostics.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A suitable ideal-gas mechanism and dependencies, known initial composition and conditions, reactor constraint, time horizon, and stated software environment.
sources.offline_assessment: The described bundled mechanism case is a conditional local numerical candidate, not an observed run or experimental validation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual histories and report against independently calculated delay and conservation checks; agreement does not establish kinetic validity or experimental relevance.

sources.workflow: Prepare a microscopy manifest, run a calibrated nuclear segmentation pipeline, and summarize object measurements with visual quality control.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Appropriate single-plane grayscale TIFFs and acquisition metadata, a unique manifest, calibrated pipeline, helper dependencies, and a separate CellProfiler runtime.
sources.offline_assessment: Manifest preparation and table summarization are described as local candidates; the segmentation workflow additionally requires the actual engine and images. No current engine run was made.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check the completion marker, measurement tables and image hashes, then compare overlays with independently annotated fields; count consistency alone does not establish segmentation accuracy.

sources.workflow: Use the authenticated manufacturing interface to configure a CAD quote, inspect manufacturability feedback and pricing, and, only when authorized, proceed through ordering and follow-up.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Network access, browser automation, the user's authenticated account, actual CAD and manufacturing requirements, export classification, and authorization for outward or financial actions.
sources.offline_assessment: A local CAD preflight is a partial candidate only; it cannot complete or verify the online quote or order workflow. No browser action or upload occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An authorized reviewer should inspect the actual CAD, drawing revision, displayed configuration, feedback and final transaction state; a historical interface snapshot or local preflight cannot establish current availability or contractual terms.

sources.workflow: Apply or construct cytometry gating strategies, including compensation and transforms, then export population counts with denominators and provenance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Local cytometry data and the actual gating strategy or workspace, matched sample and detector identities, appropriate controls, and the stated FlowKit environment.
sources.offline_assessment: Local analysis is a conditional candidate if the files and runtime exist; a workspace import alone is not demonstrated agreement with its originating application.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual gated event counts and overlays with the supplied strategy and representative independently analyzed samples; agreement on counts does not validate biological thresholds.

sources.workflow: Count existing pooled-screen reads or analyze supplied guide counts, assess screen quality, and rank enriched and depleted genes for an explicit contrast.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A verified guide library, sample and replicate metadata, explicit contrast, read structure or count matrix, and MAGeCK with its required compiled component.
sources.offline_assessment: A local synthetic or supplied-count analysis is a conditional candidate; no screen analysis or runtime check was performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile actual guide counts, sample assignments, normalization and gene rankings with the library and execution records; ranking and FDR do not establish gene function or real-screen calibration.

sources.workflow: Solve seawater carbonate speciation from two independent measurements, optionally convert conditions and propagate stated measurement uncertainties.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A valid measured pair with units, quality flags and condition basis, salinity and nutrient assumptions, selected equilibrium conventions, and the stated local solver.
sources.offline_assessment: The synthetic paired-measurement case is a conditional local candidate, not a field-data result or a completed calculation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual input conventions, carbonate balance and any independently measured third parameter against output and uncertainty records; agreement does not validate samples or omitted uncertainty sources.

sources.workflow: Process a calibrated complex one-dimensional free-induction decay into a phased spectrum, peak candidates and signed region integrals.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A supported complex time-domain input, acquisition calibration and sign convention, explicit processing settings, and the stated numerical libraries.
sources.offline_assessment: The synthetic signal and supported local input formats are conditional candidates; neither vendor decoding nor processing was verified here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual spectral axes, reference peaks and integrals with acquisition evidence and an independent calculation; synthetic agreement does not validate experimental decoding or quantitative concentrations.

sources.workflow: Convert supported two-photon image and behavioral position streams into NWB with evidence-based clock alignment, validation and round-trip checks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Supported TIFF and timestamped position inputs, session and acquisition metadata, documented shared clock or matched synchronization evidence, and the specified conversion environment.
sources.offline_assessment: A local conversion is a conditional candidate when those inputs and dependencies exist; no conversion or validation was performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual NWB pixels, timestamps, position units and clock mapping with source files and review validation findings; schema compliance cannot establish correct calibration, anatomical labels or pulse pairing.

sources.workflow: Design or audit primer candidates, assess their thermodynamics, and screen intended and unintended amplification products within a declared reference scope.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An explicit assay and versioned sequence reference, applicable annotations and constraints, reaction conditions, suitable local design tools, and additional search tools if that search mode is selected.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic local candidate is described, conditional on the assets and tools; no biological design, search or assay validation was performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile actual candidate sequences and product coordinates with the exact reference, then inspect search coverage and incomplete-result flags; bounded computational screening cannot prove empirical specificity.

sources.workflow: Simulate single-cell charge, discharge and rest with battery models, assess solver and mesh sensitivity, and optionally compare measured cycling curves.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Cell characteristics, initial state and temperature, justified parameter set, defined input sequence, compatible local runtime, and aligned measurements for comparison.
sources.offline_assessment: The bundled synthetic battery case is a conditional local candidate; the source's reported prior execution is not a new execution or measured-cell validation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recalculate charge and compare actual curves, termination events, mesh sensitivity and measured-current alignment; numerical convergence alone cannot establish cell-model validity.

sources.workflow: Calculate temperature-dependent equilibrium phase fractions and compositions from a thermodynamic database, with mass-balance and sampling-density checks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An appropriate database with documented provenance and permitted use, selected components and phases, bulk composition, pressure, temperatures, and the stated local runtime.
sources.offline_assessment: The hypothetical teaching database is a conditional local candidate, not an assessed database or a completed real-material calculation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconstruct bulk composition from actual phase outputs and compare refined sampling and same-phase vertices; these checks do not prove a global minimum or experimental database accuracy.

sources.workflow: Import paired amplicon reads, remove primers, denoise, classify sequence variants, and retain artifact provenance and read-retention evidence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Paired demultiplexed reads, matching manifest and metadata, known primer orientation and quality encoding, justified read-length choices, the specified QIIME environment, and a trusted compatible classifier.
sources.offline_assessment: The local input-validation helper is a partial candidate; full analysis additionally needs the actual runtime, reads and classifier. No validation or analysis was executed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual paired-read consistency, artifact provenance, stage-specific retention and control results; predicted overlap and valid artifacts do not establish successful merging or accurate taxonomy.

sources.workflow: Validate extracted particle metadata and stacks, perform gold-standard single-particle refinement, inspect independent half maps, and postprocess with a soft mask.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: CTF-annotated selected particles and stacks, an appropriate initial reference and acquisition metadata, justified symmetry and mask, and compatible RELION and MPI runtimes.
sources.offline_assessment: Local metadata or map checks are partial candidates; full refinement and postprocessing require the native executables and actual project data. No job was run.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual particle half-set assignments, unfiltered maps, mask and postprocessing outputs; matching map headers or a global correlation curve cannot prove half-map independence, handedness or biological correctness.

sources.workflow: Simulate deterministic kinetic-model trajectories under separate parameter conditions, export the model and experiment archive, and compare archive replay with direct outputs.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A supported local model with interpretable units and initial conditions, an explicit experiment configuration, and the specified native scientific libraries.
sources.offline_assessment: The described first-order reference is a conditional local candidate; the source's claimed prior replay is not a run or model validation performed here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual trajectory files with an independent analytical or numerical calculation and inspect archive contents and replay differences; replay agreement does not validate model assumptions or parameter identifiability.

source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
